{{Otheruses|Defense Force}}
The '''Induparan Crown Defense Force''' was the military arm of the [[Induparan Crown Worlds]]. The force cooperated [[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]] [[Soleric]]'s [[16th Escort Force]] to combat [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] around [[Indupar/Legends|Indupar]].<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>
